children: BHP's Chief Commercial Officer Rag Udd will step down at the end of January 2027 to pursue an opportunity outside of the company, Chief Executive Brandon Craig said in a memo to staff on Tuesday.
"While Rag will be missed, he leaves with our best wishes as he takes on this next opportunity," Craig said in the memo reviewed by Reuters.
